wizard_intro: MagiSentry scans Python (pip) and JavaScript (npm) packages through a 10-step scanner before they are installed. It catches typosquats, known CVEs, hidden executables and malicious code patterns.
wizard_mode_failsafe_desc: Fail Safe (default): if the scanner technically fails, installation continues with a warning. If a threat is found, installation is blocked.
wizard_mode_failsecure_desc: Fail Secure: if the scanner technically fails, installation is blocked and you are offered Retry or Skip. If a threat is found, installation is blocked.
wizard_mode_prompt: Choose mode: [1] Fail Safe   [2] Fail Secure
wizard_vt_account_prompt: Do you have a VirusTotal account? [Y/N]
wizard_vt_register_instructions: Open https://www.virustotal.com → Register → confirm e-mail → Account → API Key. Paste it below.
wizard_vt_enter_key: Enter your VirusTotal API key (or leave blank to skip step 5):
wizard_vt_invalid_key: That key was rejected by VirusTotal. Please try again.
wizard_vt_key_saved: VT_API_KEY saved. Changes will take effect after restarting the terminal.
step1_desc: Checks if package exists on the registry, its age, owner, description.
step2_desc: Looks up known CVE vulnerabilities for this exact version against Google's OSV database.
step3_desc: Scans the entire transitive dependency tree for known CVEs.
step4_desc: Downloads the package without running setup.py / postinstall scripts.
step5_desc: Sends the SHA256 hash (not the file) to 70+ AV engines via VirusTotal. Free, 500/day.
step6_desc: Detects real file types inside the package (offline ML model). Catches hidden .exe/.dll/.elf etc.
step7_desc: Looks for suspicious code patterns: eval(), exec(), base64+exec, .env reads, network on import.
step1_threat_not_found: Package '{package}' was not found on the registry — possible typosquat.
step1_warning_few_releases: Only {count} release(s) on the registry — the package has very little history.
step1_warning_too_new: Package was first published {days} day(s) ago — younger than 30 days.
step1_warning_no_description: Package has no description / summary on the registry.
step1_failure_network: Could not reach the package registry.
step1_cause_network: PyPI / npm registry unreachable, or no internet connection.
step1_recommend_network: Check your internet connection and try again.
step2_cause_osv: Google OSV service may be down or unreachable.
step2_recommend_osv: Retry in a moment, or skip this step.
step2_failure_no_version: Could not determine an exact version for {package} — refusing to query OSV without one.
step2_cause_no_version: PyPI / npm registry was unreachable when resolving the latest version. A version-less OSV query would return historical CVEs as fresh threats.
step2_recommend_no_version: Retry once your network is back, or pin a version (e.g. `{package}==1.2.3`).
step3_threat_dep_cve: pip-audit found {count} vulnerability/vulnerabilities in the dependency tree of {package}.
step3_cause_pipaudit: pip-audit not installed, network down, or PyPI Advisory DB unreachable.
step3_recommend_pipaudit: Install pip-audit (`pip install pip-audit`) and retry.
step3_skipped_npm: pip-audit only scans Python packages — skipped for npm.
step4_cause_download: Network error, full disk, or missing permissions in temp directory.
step5_threat_av: VirusTotal: {malicious} engine(s) flagged as malicious, {suspicious} as suspicious (out of {total}).
step5_warning_single_engine: VirusTotal: {malicious} malicious / {suspicious} suspicious of {total} engines — below threshold, treated as informational.
step5_failure_no_key: VT_API_KEY environment variable is not set.
step5_cause_no_key: VirusTotal needs a free API key to query.
step5_recommend_no_key: Run `magisentry config --wizard` to enter a key, or disable step 5.
step5_recommend_rate_limit: Wait a minute and retry, or skip this step.
step5_cause_network: Network error or VT service degraded.
step6_threat_executable: Magika detected suspicious file type '{type}' inside the package: {file}
step6_warning_benign_script: Magika detected '{type}' script '{file}' — content inspection found no download/exec markers, treated as benign helper.
step7_warning_test_only: Semgrep flagged {count} pattern(s), all inside test / fixtures / docs / examples — treated as informational.
step8_warning_far_match: Yara matched {count} rule(s) where strings are too far apart to be a single attack chain — informational: {rules}
step9_desc: Checks publisher reputation, install count, age, and (if VT_API_KEY set) the .vsix hash against VirusTotal.
step8_failure_bad_id: '{package}' is not a valid extension id (expected publisher.name).
step8_cause_bad_id: VS Code extension ids must contain a dot.
step8_failure_network: Could not reach Open VSX or the VS Code Marketplace.
step8_cause_network: Network error or both registries unreachable.
step8_recommend_network: Check your internet connection and retry.
step8_warning_abandoned: Extension last updated {days} day(s) ago — likely abandoned.
step8_warning_single_ext_publisher: Publisher '{publisher}' has only 1 extension ever published.
step8_note_single_ext_publisher: Note: publisher '{publisher}' currently has 1 extension. Common for new indie developers — informational only.
step8_warning_new_verified_publisher: Extension is new ({installs} installs) but publisher '{publisher}' is domain-verified — treated as informational.
step8_threat_new_low_install: Only {installs} install(s) and the extension is younger than 90 days.
step8_threat_vt: VirusTotal: {malicious} engine(s) flagged the .vsix as malicious.
step10_desc: Parses the Dockerfile RUN instructions, extracts every pip/npm install, and checks each package via steps 1+2+3 before docker build proceeds.
step9_recommend_parse: Verify the path and that the file exists.
step9_no_installs: No pip / npm install commands found in {path}.
step9_clean: All {count} package(s) declared in the Dockerfile passed steps 1+2+3.
step9_threat_summary: Dockerfile contains {count} package(s) with known issues:
step10_private_pkg_warn: Package {package} not found on PyPI — may be internal/private. Verify manually.
audit_no_manifests: No pyproject.toml / requirements.txt / package.json found in {path}.
audit_summary: Audit complete: {total} package(s) scanned — {clean} clean, {failures} unverifiable, {threats} with threats.
step7_failure_not_installed: Semgrep is not installed — step 7 cannot run.
step7_cause_not_installed: Semgrep is optional. Without it, static-analysis checks are unavailable.
step7_recommend_not_installed: Install Semgrep (`pip install semgrep`) or disable step 7.
step7_recommend_crash: Skip this step and report the package to the project.
step8_yara_desc: Runs MagiSentry's Yara rules (credential_theft / base64_exec / env_exfiltration / auto_run_on_import) against extracted source files. Requires `yara-python`.

cli_usage:
Usage:
  magisentry pip install <package>
  magisentry npm install <package>
  magisentry vscode install <publisher.extension>
  magisentry docker build <Dockerfile-or-context-dir>
  magisentry audit [path]
  magisentry uninstall
  magisentry config [--wizard | --mode failsafe|failsecure | --lang en|sk | --notifications on|off | --enable <step-key> | --disable <step-key>]
  magisentry whitelist [list | add pip:<package> | remove pip:<package>]
